title.zh: 10月5日18:09 UTC核对：无新伤亡公报
title.en: 5 Oct 18:09 UTC check: no newer official toll
title.ne: 5 Oct 18:09 UTC: naya official toll chaina
title.hi: 5 Oct 18:09 UTC: naya official toll nahi

body.zh: 本轮再核新华社、gov.cn、交通厅与@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus：中方仍为9月5日18时，43死、519失联、2人获救。尼方仍用epardafas 10月4日引述的周日5时：1456具遗体、4718名失踪；获救仍用NDRRMA 9月26日13795。堰塞湖仍为新华社9月5日已排空。G216仍为9月28日双向管制。美使馆道路告示仍为9月3日。无新UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS激活。
body.en: Recheck of Xinhua, gov.cn, transport dept and @XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN remains 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. NP stays epardafas 4 Oct citing Sunday 05:00: 1456 bodies, 4718 missing; rescued stays NDRRMA 26 Sep figure 13795. Barrier lake remains Xinhua 5 Sep drained. G216 remains 28 Sep two-way control. US Embassy road notice remains 3 Sep. No new UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS activation.
body.ne: Xinhua/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN 5 Sep 18:00 43/519/2. NP epardafas 4 Oct aaitabar 05:00 1456 sharir, 4718 harayeka. Uddar NDRRMA 26 Sep 13795. Tal Xinhua 5 Sep khali. G216 28 Sep niyantran. US Embassy notice 3 Sep. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS chaina.
body.hi: Xinhua/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN 5 Sep 18:00 43/519/2. NP epardafas 4 Oct ravivar 05:00 1456 sharir, 4718 lapata. Uddhar NDRRMA 26 Sep 13795. Jheel Xinhua 5 Sep khali. G216 28 Sep niyantran. US Embassy notice 3 Sep. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS nahi.

title.zh: 央视10月4日：中尼科考队从成都启程赴尼
title.en: CCTV 4 Oct: China-Nepal science team left Chengdu for Nepal
title.ne: CCTV 4 Oct: science team Chengdu bata Nepal tira
title.hi: CCTV 4 Oct: science team Chengdu se Nepal ke liye

body.zh: 央视10月4日：喜马拉雅8·26应急跨境科考队50余人从成都启程赴尼，溯源冰岩崩并服务吉隆口岸重建。无新伤亡，无现场坐标。
body.en: CCTV 4 Oct: 50-plus researchers of the Himalaya 26 Aug emergency team left Chengdu for Nepal to trace the ice-rock avalanche and support Gyirong Port reconstruction. No new casualties, no field coordinates.
body.ne: CCTV 4 Oct: 50+ scientist Chengdu bata Nepal tira. Naya casualty chaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: CCTV 4 Oct: 50+ scientist Chengdu se Nepal ke liye. Naya casualty nahi. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: Equity Nepal：周日11时仍为1456具遗体

body.zh: Equity Nepal 10月4日：周日11时仍寻获1456具遗体（8区1454，加德满都治疗中死亡2人）。遗体DNA 1336、亲属2077。未更新失踪与获救数。
body.en: Equity Nepal 4 Oct: as of Sunday 11:00, 1456 bodies recovered (1454 in eight districts plus 2 deaths in Kathmandu treatment). DNA: 1336 deceased, 2077 relatives. Missing and rescued not updated.
body.ne: Equity Nepal 4 Oct: aaitabar 11:00, 1456 sharir. DNA mritak 1336, natidar 2077. Harayeka/uddar update chaina.
body.hi: Equity Nepal 4 Oct: ravivar 11:00, 1456 sharir. DNA mritak 1336, rishte 2077. Lapata/uddhar update nahi.

body.zh: epardafas：截至周日5时已寻获1456具遗体，仍寻4718名失踪者。警力7975人。未更新获救数。
body.en: epardafas: as of Sunday 05:00, 1456 bodies recovered; search continues for 4718 missing. 7975 police deployed. Rescued not updated.
body.ne: epardafas: aaitabar 05:00, 1456 sharir, 4718 harayeka. Police 7975. Uddar update chaina.
body.hi: epardafas: ravivar 05:00, 1456 sharir, 4718 lapata. Police 7975. Uddhar update nahi.

title.zh: NDRRMA 10月1日：搜救结束，转入失踪核查
title.en: NDRRMA 1 Oct: SAR ended, missing verification starts
title.ne: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj sakiyo, harayeka jaanch suru
title.hi: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj khatam, lapata satyapan shuru

body.zh: epardafas引NDRRMA执行主任Upreti：10月1日记者会称博特科西—特里舒里水道搜救阶段结束，转入恢复与失踪人员核查。未公布新伤亡数字。无新队伍坐标。
body.en: epardafas cites NDRRMA chief Upreti: 1 Oct press conference said Bhotekoshi-Trishuli SAR ended and recovery plus missing-person verification began. No new casualty figures. No new team coordinates.
body.ne: epardafas/NDRRMA Upreti: 1 Oct khoj sakiyo, recovery ra harayeka jaanch suru. Naya casualty chaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: epardafas/NDRRMA Upreti: 1 Oct khoj khatam, recovery aur lapata satyapan shuru. Naya casualty nahi. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: 交通厅9月28日：G216吉隆镇—国门仍双向管制
title.en: Transport dept 28 Sep: G216 town-gate still controlled
title.ne: Transport 28 Sep: G216 dui tira niyantran
title.hi: Transport 28 Sep: G216 dono disha niyantran

body.zh: 西藏自治区交通运输厅路网：G216 K3500+200（吉隆镇）—K3525+850（吉隆国门）自8月26日起双向交通管制，解除时间待定。本轮无更新。
body.en: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200 (Gyirong town) to K3525+850 (gate) remains two-way controlled since 26 Aug; lift time unset. No update this cycle.
body.ne: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200-K3525+850 26 Aug dekhi dui tira niyantran. Yo cycle update chaina.
body.hi: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200-K3525+850 26 Aug se dono disha niyantran. Is cycle update nahi.

body.zh: PTI引NDRRMA 9月26日：1453死、5285失踪、13795获救。死亡与失踪已被10月4日口径替代；KPI获救仍用此数，因本轮无更新。
body.en: PTI cites NDRRMA 26 Sep: 1453 dead, 5285 missing, 13795 rescued. Dead and missing superseded by 4 Oct figures; KPI rescued stays at 13795 because this cycle has no newer rescued figure.
body.ne: PTI/NDRRMA 26 Sep: uddar 13795. Mrit/harayeka 4 Oct le badleko. Uddar naya chaina.
body.hi: PTI/NDRRMA 26 Sep: uddhar 13795. Mrit/lapata 4 Oct se badle. Uddhar naya nahi.

title.zh: 指挥部9月6日：截至9月5日18时 43死519失联
title.en: Command 6 Sep: as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing
title.ne: Command 6 Sep: 5 Sep 18:00, 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin

body.zh: 人民日报引吉隆应急救援指挥部：43人遇难、519人失联、成功救出2人、遗物993件。外籍失联261人、23国。此后新华社与@XHNews未见更新伤亡。
body.en: People's Daily cites the Gyirong command: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued, 993 personal effects. 261 missing foreigners from 23 countries. No later casualty update from Xinhua or @XHNews.
body.ne: Command: 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin, 2 uddar. Bideshi 261. Xinhua pachi naya casualty chaina.
body.hi: Command: 43 mrit, 519 lapata, 2 uddhar. Videshi 261. Xinhua ke baad naya casualty nahi.

title.zh: 新华社9月5日：口岸上方堰塞湖已排空
title.en: Xinhua 5 Sep: barrier lake above the port drained
title.ne: Xinhua 5 Sep: port mathi ko bandha tal khali
title.hi: Xinhua 5 Sep: port ke upar ka barrier lake khali

body.zh: 新华社引应急管理部门：口岸核心区上方堰塞湖已排空，河道恢复过流，险情基本解除。本轮无新堰塞湖通报。
body.en: Xinhua cites emergency management: lake above the port core has drained, the channel is flowing, and the hazard is largely eliminated. No later barrier-lake bulletin.
body.ne: Xinhua: tal khali, nadi sadharan, jokhim hatyo. Pachi naya tal bulletin chaina.
body.hi: Xinhua: jheel khali, nadi normal, khatra hat gaya. Baad mein naya jheel bulletin nahi.

title.zh: 美国驻尼使馆9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi-Timure
title.en: US Embassy Nepal 3 Sep: do not travel Rasuwagadhi-Timure
title.hi: US Embassy 3 Sep: Rasuwagadhi-Timure mat jao

body.zh: 使馆道路告示仍为9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi。本轮未见更新告示。
body.en: Embassy road notice remains 3 Sep: do not travel to Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi. No newer notice found.
body.ne: Embassy notice 3 Sep nai: Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi najau. Naya notice chaina.
body.hi: Embassy notice 3 Sep hi: Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi mat jao. Naya notice nahi.

detail.zh: 口岸设施已毁，通关未恢复。中方关闭。
detail.en: Port facilities destroyed; clearance not restored. Chinese side closed.
detail.ne: Port dhvasta; clearance khuleko chaina. Chiniya taraf band.
detail.hi: Port dhvast; clearance nahi. Chini taraf band.

detail.zh: 交通厅9月28日路网：K3500+200—K3525+850双向管制，解除时间待定。抢险通道仅救援。
detail.en: Transport bulletin 28 Sep: K3500+200-K3525+850 two-way control, lift time unset. Rescue track only.
detail.ne: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200-K3525+850 dui tira niyantran. Rescue bato matra.
detail.hi: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200-K3525+850 dono disha niyantran. Rescue path hi.

detail.zh: 截至9月5日18时：2500余人，核心区搜寻与消杀已覆盖。无新现场坐标。
detail.en: As of 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ personnel; core search and disinfection covered. No new live GNSS.
detail.ne: 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ jana; core khoj cover. Naya GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ log; core khoj cover. Naya GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: NDRRMA 10月1日：搜救阶段结束，转入失踪核查。epardafas周日5时仍部7975名警员处置遗体并寻找失踪者。无新队伍坐标，故不标经纬度。
detail.en: NDRRMA 1 Oct: SAR phase ended; missing-person verification underway. epardafas Sunday 05:00 still lists 7975 police on remains and missing search. No new team GNSS, so no lat/lng.
detail.ne: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj sakiyo. epardafas 05:00: police 7975. Toli GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj khatam. epardafas 05:00: police 7975. Team GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: 9月5日指挥部：核心区搜寻与预防性消杀已全覆盖。
detail.en: 5 Sep command: core-area search and preventive disinfection fully covered.
detail.ne: 5 Sep command: core khoj ra disinfection cover.
detail.hi: 5 Sep command: core khoj aur disinfection cover.

detail.zh: 8月30日发布会：转移安置吉隆镇、萨勒乡5村499人。9月8日新华社称444人已返回。本轮无更新。
detail.en: 30 Aug briefing: 499 relocated from Gyirong town and Sale. Xinhua 8 Sep: 444 returned after lake risk eased. No update this cycle.
detail.ne: 30 Aug: 499 sthanantran. Xinhua 8 Sep: 444 firta. Yo cycle update chaina.
detail.hi: 30 Aug: 499 sthanantran. Xinhua 8 Sep: 444 wapas. Is cycle update nahi.

status.zh: 堰塞湖已排空，河道正常过流（新华社9月5日，本轮无更新）
status.en: Barrier lake drained; channel flowing normally (Xinhua 5 Sep, no update this cycle)
status.ne: Bandha tal khali; nadi sadharan (Xinhua 5 Sep, yo cycle update chaina)
status.hi: Barrier lake khali; nadi normal (Xinhua 5 Sep, is cycle update nahi)

text.zh: @XHNews 9月10日：国家气候中心向尼泊尔提供滚动气候监测与预报，支持吉隆—拉苏瓦口岸泥石流救援。无新伤亡。
text.en: @XHNews 10 Sep: National Climate Center is providing Nepal rolling climate monitoring and forecasts for Gyirong-Rasuwa mudslide relief. No new casualties.
text.ne: @XHNews 10 Sep: National Climate Center le Nepal lai Gyirong-Rasuwa mudslide uddar ko lagi climate forecast diyo. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: @XHNews 10 Sep: National Climate Center Nepal ko Gyirong-Rasuwa mudslide relief ke liye climate forecast de raha hai. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: @CCTV_Plus 9月10日：灾后留在吉隆镇的尼泊尔务工人员恢复工作。无新伤亡数字。
text.en: @CCTV_Plus 10 Sep: Nepali workers who stayed in disaster-hit Gyirong town are returning to work. No new casualty figures.
text.ne: @CCTV_Plus 10 Sep: Gyirong town ma baseka Nepali karmiharu kaam ma pharke. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: @CCTV_Plus 10 Sep: Gyirong town mein ruke Nepali karmchari kaam par laut rahe hain. Naya casualty nahi.
